**Current workspace — v0.1.0**
One destination: left competition sidebar, right scrolling question list. First available competition selected by default. Label: Name · Year · Position/exam; full label discoverable. Ghost trigger: visible expanded; collapsed expand icon revealed on hover/focus, with touch fallback. Activation changes layout; hover alone does not. Collapse preserves page and answers. Ten questions per page, footer pagination. Phone and navigation loading/failure are proposals. No additional routes. Exact breakpoint, drawer, ordering and data recovery remain open.
